title.en: An Act Creating the Municipality of Imelda in the Province of Camarines Norte
title.orig: An Act Creating the Municipality of Imelda in the Province of Camarines Norte

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1970/ra_6144_1970.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Barrios Daculangbolo, Laniton, Langga, Maisog, Dagotdotan, Mampurog, Matacong, in the Municipality of Daet, Province of Camarines Norte and barrios San Isidro, San Antonio, San Ramon, Manlimonsito, Salvacion in the Municipality of Basud, Province of Camarines Norte, are hereby separated from their respective municipalities and constituted into a distinct and independent municipality, to be known as the Municipality of Imelda, in the same province. The seat of government of the new municipality shall be in the present site of Barrio Matacong.

The new municipality shall acquire corporate existence upon the election and qualification of the first mayor, vice-mayor and councilors who shall be elected in the next general election for local officials.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: November 9, 1970.
